s.note: the LAIRE battle in the park and the court of King Argotron
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 12 chicken drumsticks with 2 tbsp oil, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Wrap the bones in baking paper and serve on a board.

s.n: Sturdy Wings honey soy chicken wings
s.note: Sturdy Wings, the mentoring programme Danny and Wheeler are sentenced to
s.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and bake on a rack for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Simmer 4 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 tbsp rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy. Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

m.note: Wheeler finally getting through to Ronnie
m.how: Bake 750g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and chopped pickles. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties with diced onion and pickles.

w.n: Kingdom of LAIRE honey spice cakes
w.how: Heat the oven to 175C. Melt 125g butter with 150g honey, cool slightly, then whisk in 2 eggs. Fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp mixed spice and 80ml milk. Divide between 12 greased muffin holes and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Warm 4 tbsp honey with the juice of 1 orange and spoon over the hot cakes. Serve with thick cream and toasted flaked almonds.

d.note: the Minotaur energy drink Danny and Wheeler sell to schools
d.how: Simmer 100g sliced ginger, 120g sugar, 150ml water and a pinch of chilli flakes for 10 minutes. Cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml ginger syrup and 25ml lime juice to each and top with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with a lime wheel and mint.
